name: dialectic-skills
description: Marketplace for the dia plugin: twelve instruction-only reasoning-and-review skills and a short dia menu.

plugins.name: dia
plugins.description: Twelve reasoning-and-review skills: intent confirmation, Socratic elenchus and brainstorming, reductio ad absurdum, negative dialectics, argument warrants, Lakatosian counterexamples, dialectical-inquiry counterplans, single-pass refine, review rounds gated by outside evidence (ratchet), rulings on others' reports about a text, and rules for text a model follows, plus dia-menu, a short entry point (type dia).
